claim_one_line: T-NORM ON THE FRAME'S MATTER (P-525; data-free; refereed hostile, PASS WITH CORRECTIONS): FR-FIB's matter zero modes (one quaternion-type doublet per field times the blocks QJ, QI, QK) give the generation Gram matrix G = H ||F_x||^2, so T-NORM holds exactly in the chosen metric H = I, the one the census uses (306 twist classes, off-diagonals <= 2e-12, refined to 1e-15; reproduced by independent code); but the flat structure leaves H free -- 8 real parameters per field (2 under the diagonal SU(2) of the frame's holonomy) -- and the outputs move with it (a democratic 0.1 mixing shifts the mass ratios by 0.045 decades and |V| by 0.08): 'no new freedom' is false for the flat structure and H = I is a CHOSEN input; B1654's section 1.11 argument proves at best a diagonal H (P-146's dismissal refuted). None of the 19.
